did.description: The member whose posts are counted.

days.description: Range in days: 30, 90 or 365. 0 (default) means all time.

main.description: Engagement statistics for one member's Zeens photo posts, for Studio's Stats tab: totals and top posts for posts published in the range, and when likes, reposts and replies arrived (from the engagement ledger: a like's record key is a TID, which carries its time). All of it is derived from public engagement records; no views exist on AT Protocol.
